thread:
elaine: Hey team — Zephyr trial (tenant 7642, key z-03) is hitting intermittent 429s during a bulk embeddings import. Starts after ~15m, can we triage?

jordan: Copy. Which endpoint and do we have a failing req id?

elaine: Endpoint: POST /v1/embeddings. They upload a CSV ~10k rows and use 10 parallel workers. Fail req ids: req_8f3a, req_8f3b.

mike_oncall: 10 workers + steady stream = likely per-route burst or trial token budget exhaustion. Hosted tenant?

nora_zephyr: Yes hosted. We tried adding jitter but bursts still appear. Each worker ~1-2 reqs/sec.

jordan: quota-bot posted an alert a minute ago:

quota-bot: "Alert: tenant 7642 exceeded per-route burst window twice in the last 10m. 429s returned. Route: embeddings.create. Peak token rate 1.2k/s"

mike_oncall: Matches hypothesis. Quick remediation options: 1) throttle concurrency to 4-6 workers; 2) switch to larger batch sizes so fewer requests overall; 3) we can do a temporary soft limit override for demo.

jordan: Elaine — can sales/Zephyr accept a temporary soft bump and potential trial credit consumption?

elaine: They need the import complete by EOD. Zephyr approves a one-off soft bump for the demo. Tell me expected cost impact.

mike_oncall: I'll apply a temporary +2x soft_limit on embeddings.create for tenant 7642 for 3 hours. This is not SLA-backed and will draw from trial credits. Applying now — patching config.

jordan: Diagnostic curl to run if they see another 429 (please paste output):

```bash
curl -i -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings \
 -H "Authorization: Bearer <KEY>" \
 -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
 -d '{"model":"rwd-embed-compact","input":["sample text"],"batch_size":128}'
```

elaine: After the override we still saw one 429 (req_8f3c) then 200s. Seems to settle.

mike_oncall: In-flight requests can still hit 429s while accounting stabilizes. If persistent after 2m, escalate. I'll annotate tenant record with the change so finance sees trial credit usage.

jordan: Logged an eng follow-up ticket with req ids req_8f3a, req_8f3b, req_8f3c + tenant 7642 + logs to check token_accounting traces and whether burst window duration needs tuning.

elaine: Finance question from Zephyr — will the soft bump be charged or consumed from trial credits?

mike_oncall: It will consume trial credits first. If they exceed free credits we'll flag for billing outreach. I'll set a monitor and notify sales if they cross threshold.

nora_zephyr: Thanks — we'll reduce workers to 5 and retry the import now.

jordan: Long-term presales notes: add checklist entry for bulk imports — expected concurrency, batch_size, tokens/min estimate, and recommend batch endpoints for large datasets. Also call out reserved capacity or Dedicated for heavy/production imports.

elaine: Agreed. Follow-ups: 1) eng ticket for trace; 2) update presales playbook; 3) add runbook note about temporary soft bumps and how to document cost impact.

mike_oncall: Running the runbook update now. Temporary override expires +3h.

quota-bot: "Info: temporary override applied to tenant 7642 (embeddings.create) until +3h by mike_oncall"

elaine: Appreciate the fast turnaround. I'll confirm with Zephyr if they'll convert to a paid pilot later today.
